skill.name: payload
skill.description: Builds full-stack applications with Payload CMS, the Next.js-native headless CMS. Use when creating content-driven apps with TypeScript, code-first configuration, and full control over your backend.

generated_query: I'm building a personal blog where I write about tech and travel. I want a self-hosted backend with full control over my data models, using Next.js and TypeScript. I need to set up a CMS that lets me manage posts, categories, and media. Can you help me scaffold the project and create the collection schemas? Specifically, I need a Posts collection with fields for title, auto-generated slug, rich text content, a featured image upload, relationship to author (linked to Users), multiple categories, a status (draft/published), and a published date. Also, I want access control so that only I (an authenticated user) can create or edit posts, but any visitor can read published posts. Finally, I'd like to have versioning with drafts enabled.
